claim_ceiling: Proposed benchmark protocol and synthetic mechanics only. No real dwelling performance, event probability, physical safety, habitability, cost advantage, code compliance, or industry superiority is established.

benchmark_arms.purpose: Measure the documented conventional/manual workflow and human effort; do not assume its quality or speed.
benchmark_arms.required_evidence: Frozen task brief, operator qualifications, elapsed time, human-hours, inputs, exclusions and decision record.

benchmark_arms.purpose: Best-available incumbent specialist tools applied to the same eligible subtasks, inputs and decision brief.
benchmark_arms.required_evidence: Exact product/software version, modules, configuration, licence/access conditions, operator time, compute, source data and outputs. Use a tool only for tasks inside its supported scope.

benchmark_arms.purpose: Use the same eligible specialist engines and outputs as B1, adding Luminous evidence identity, scope/rights/revision control, compound-trace pairing, owner-native outcome bindings, invalidation and replay.
benchmark_arms.required_evidence: B1 engine identity and input/output digests plus exact evidence-composition receipts and owner contract versions.

benchmark_arms.purpose: Best incumbent specialist toolchain plus only the Luminous layers shown to add measurable value; report every retained and replaced tool.
benchmark_arms.required_evidence: Same as B1 and B2, including explicit system boundary and who performed each action.

benchmark_arms.purpose: Exhaustive independent oracle for small finite synthetic cases only; diagnostic reference, never a deployable competitor or physical truth.
benchmark_arms.required_evidence: Frozen finite state space, independently authored evaluator, exact expected feasible/Pareto sets and oracle source digest.

matched_comparison_requirements: Identical Highveld geometry/design revision and resident/task requirement revision across paired arms.
Identical exogenous event corpus bytes, scenario IDs, revision and SHA-256 digest across paired arms.
Identical initial conditions, resource limits, boundary conditions and declared information budget.
No future-event information to a candidate except a separately labelled B4-style oracle upper bound.
Same output functional units, time horizons, time steps, denominator definitions and uncertainty reporting wherever comparison is claimed.
Record software/tool versions, licences, model options, compute budget, human/operator time, manual edits, retries, failures and exclusions.
Use the same source-data snapshots and rights state; a tool unavailable to one arm must be disclosed rather than silently substituted.
Design selection, operational-control policy and post-occupancy observation are separate experiments with separate outputs.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Highveld design/stress binding and climate-source admission; preserve weather product, station/grid, location, baseline, timestep, representativeness, rights and revision.
owner_crosswalk.do_not_duplicate: No weather archive or climate qualification engine.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Reference dwelling, household-service definitions and architecture candidate identities.
owner_crosswalk.do_not_duplicate: No duplicate service product or architecture registry.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Compound-event evidence register, synthetic traces, evidence class, scope joins and matched trace manifest.
owner_crosswalk.do_not_duplicate: No service timeline, causal engine or resilience evaluator.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Existing deterministic event clock, paired policies, lost/restored service trajectories, service floors, recovery and Pareto evaluation.
owner_crosswalk.adapter_boundary: Only translate a qualified, owner-approved service loss/restoration into the exact owner-native event schema; preserve the source trace and provenance alongside it. Do not inject raw climate, utility or component-fault evidence as a native service event.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Service outcome binding and read-only post-occupancy outcome/comparability.
owner_crosswalk.do_not_duplicate: No new universal resilience score or post-occupancy evaluator.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Building instrument-channel capability/admission by measurand, placement, calibration, rights, local acquisition and decision scope.
owner_crosswalk.do_not_duplicate: No new sensor passport or physical-measurement authority.

owner_crosswalk.responsibility: Evidence validity envelope and dependency-scoped invalidation.
Finite-state decision impact, measurement choice, adaptive measurement policy and stopping rules.
Version-pinned EnergyPlus/thermal adapter, model input/output, convergence, validation and uncertainty.

metrics.definition: Count of paired candidate comparisons whose exogenous trace digest differs.
Count of non-oracle decisions exposed to events or observations unavailable at decision time.
Count of seeded missing, stale, revoked, out-of-scope, conflicting, non-converged or unqualified critical inputs admitted as PASS.
Count of source records promoted to a finer or different physical scope without an approved join.
Count of dependent results reused after a declared upstream source, rights, geometry, instrument or model revision invalidation trigger.
Exact match to independently authored interval, scope, decision-state and replay known answers.
Detected/blocked seeded adversarial controls, reported by family with numerator and denominator.
Independent-oracle dependency nodes invalidated despite no path from the changed source.
Different canonical output digests for identical frozen inputs, versions and deterministic execution settings.
Low-fidelity candidates admitted as hard-feasible that fail the approved higher-fidelity/reference check; report denominator and confidence/coverage.
|P_candidate intersect P_exhaustive| / |P_exhaustive| on finite cases with identical objective bounds and hard constraints.
|P_candidate intersect P_exhaustive| / |P_candidate| on finite cases.
Fraction of frozen candidate comparisons whose ordering reverses between screening and qualified reference evaluation; report by objective and cause, do not hide reversals in a mean.
Fraction of screened decisions that remain feasible and unchanged under the qualified reference, with Pareto-set retention reported separately.
Hours each declared resident/task floor is met, by resident and task; retain service-specific units and intervals.
Unserved hours by service, resident/task, and event trace.
Elapsed time from scenario start to first declared hard service-floor breach.
Time to reserve depletion, only where a qualified reserve state and service demand model exist.
Time to the owner-defined stable recovery condition, not merely first restoration.
Count of residents with at least one failed mandatory floor; do not average across residents.
Applicable Standard 140 test groups and exact software/version results; report applicability and exclusions.
Residuals and uncertainty against held-out measured/reference observations for declared outputs and operating domain.
Instrument, placement, acquisition, calibration, synchronization and derived-output uncertainty; include covariance assumptions.
Count of predictions outside approved applicability or without successful convergence.
Measured operator, engineering, review and rework hours from frozen brief to reproducible decision package.
Wall-clock elapsed time including data preparation, solver time, review and correction.
Precision and recall of affected downstream artifacts against independently authored dependency oracle.
Repair labour, part wait, service interruption and requalification time; no guessed values.
Oracle-admissible synthetic service decisions preserved by B2 as PASS with SATISFIED hard floor, divided by all oracle-admissible PASS/SATISFIED service decisions.
Oracle-admissible PASS/SATISFIED service cases rejected, blocked or marked unknown by B2.
Seeded adversarial cases where B2 returns PASS despite invalid rights, unapproved scope, future information or a violated/unknown resident service floor.

benchmark_stages.entry: Frozen schema, corpus and independently authored known answers.
benchmark_stages.exit: 100% known-answer agreement, 100% seeded-control detection, zero critical false passes and deterministic replay.

benchmark_stages.entry: Same candidate/input/trace digest across B0-B3; exact tool versions and measured human/compute budgets.
benchmark_stages.exit: Published per-task scorecards and complete exclusions; no aggregate winner if tasks are not comparable.

benchmark_stages.entry: Version-pinned model, applicable Standard 140 suite, verified inputs, measured reference and held-out validation plan.
benchmark_stages.exit: Model-specific VVUQ evidence accepted by the relevant domain owner; no synthetic benchmark can satisfy this stage.

benchmark_stages.entry: Safety-reviewed unoccupied test cell #4531, instrument admission #6025, calibrated reference methods and approved test procedures.
benchmark_stages.exit: Repeatable subsystem measurements, uncertainty, failure detection and safe recovery evidence.

benchmark_stages.entry: Resident consent, privacy/purpose constraints, independent instrument admission and a pre-registered comparison protocol.
benchmark_stages.exit: Read-only resident/service outcomes and comparability through #633/#700; no model self-certification.

proposed_targets_not_results.synthetic_mechanics: 100% exact known-answer match and seeded-control detection; zero false PASS.
proposed_targets_not_results.paired_comparisons: 100% identical exogenous trace and initial-state identity; zero unlabelled oracle leakage.
proposed_targets_not_results.critical_constraints: Zero false-feasible decisions after qualified reference checking; no compensating scalar score.
proposed_targets_not_results.decision_quality: 100% Pareto precision/recall on finite exhaustive oracle cases; held-out real-world targets require a measured baseline and preregistration.
proposed_targets_not_results.lifecycle: Demonstrate lower human-hours or rework than B0/B1 at equivalent decision quality before claiming productivity superiority.
proposed_targets_not_results.physical_credibility: Use model- and measurand-specific tolerances; no universal thermal, air, water or energy threshold is set by this contract.

prohibited_claims_until_qualified: No SOTA or industry-superiority claim from synthetic corpus results.
No habitability, health, fire, structural, water-potability or life-safety claim from synthetic simulation.
No household-level outage or tap-level service claim from national/system/municipal context alone.
No empirical probability or joint hazard rate from scenario counts or marginal event frequencies.
No universal resilience scalar that permits one resident's mandatory service-floor failure to be compensated by another metric.
No use of BOPTEST, ASHRAE 140, EnergyPlus, Forma or TestFit outside each tool's defined scope.

service_event_handoff_controls.purpose: Prevent upstream infrastructure events from being promoted to household service transitions without a qualified named-service outcome and owner-approved clock mapping.

audit_scope: matched B1/B2 specialist engine identity and raw input/output digests
B2 composition receipt binding to matched inputs and engine I/O
B2 per-service rights and scope validation
B2 valid-case coverage and false-rejection gate to prevent an always-BLOCKED degenerate strategy
paired_experiment_protocol.claim_ceiling: The auditor checks submitted experiment packets and synthetic self-tests only. It does not execute specialist tools or establish physical building performance. A B2 PASS requires both zero critical false passes and full preservation of oracle-admissible clean cases; an always-block strategy cannot pass.
paired_experiment_protocol.receipt_digest_recomputation: SHA-256 over the versioned fixed-field, length-prefixed UTF-8 receipt encoding; tamper detection is part of the Rust audit.
